Repulse Burst.name: Repulse Burst
Repulse Burst.description: The user slaps a target with an open palm, marking them with a pole, and repels them in the same instant. It deals force damage and throws the target a few strides back and off their feet, with or without metal on them; held back, it only shoves them away and breaks any hold they had on the user. Strain: light.
